thread:
jamie_oncall: heads up — we're seeing a sharp spike in 504s from the hosted inference gateway in us-west-2 starting ~T-5m. customer tickets coming in. any immediate context?

lina_support: saw 20+ CS tickets in the last 10m, mostly timeouts on /v1/generate. customers report partial responses then `upstream timeout` errors.

ryan_prod: confirmation from edge logs: gateway returning 504s with reason `upstream read timeout` for requests routed to the gpu-pool-3 cluster. error rate jumped from ~0.1% to ~6%.

ina_sre: tagging oncall. @ina_sre are we seeing backend pod restarts or OOMs?

ina_sre: no restarts in the serving fleet. CPU/GPU utilization normal, but connection counts to the model-backends are hitting limits on the proxy side. suspect connpool exhaustion + long-tail responses causing backlog.

maria_eng: interesting — we rolled a small model cached change an hour ago but it was non-blocking. I'll double-check the inference runtime logs for KV cache stall.

deploy-bot: deploy report: no recent prod rollouts in us-west-2 in the last 2h.

lina_support: customers affected include two large PLG accounts — both reported timeouts at 11:05 PST, impact on webhook retries. escalation opened.

jamie_oncall: mitigation path suggestions? can we route traffic to eu-west temporarily or enable degraded-mode fallback to smaller model?

ryan_prod: We can enable automatic fallback to model-compact-1 for routes that tolerate lower quality — takes ~5min to flip routing policy. Also can increase gateway upstream timeout from 15s -> 30s as emergency knee-jerk.

ina_sre: quick check: running `netstat -anp | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l` on proxy nodes shows ~3x expected TCP connections. the proxy's connection limit is 65k / worker; but ephemeral port exhaustion at the OS level is happening for some hosts.

maria_eng: if ephemeral ports exhausted, new connections get queued and the gateway sees backlog => timeouts. any long-lived idle connections?

ina_sre: yes, spool of idle gRPC streams not closing due to a bug in client keepalive. opening a patch now. temporary workaround: recycle the proxy workers one at a time to free ports.

jamie_oncall: action: initiate rolling restart of proxy workers in us-west-2 (one at a time). lina, please notify support team and affected customers we're investigating and may have short retries.

lina_support: on it — sending template: "We're actively investigating timeouts in US-West, temporary mitigation in progress. Expect reduced error rate in 10-15m." :telephone_receiver:

ryan_prod: executing fallback to model-compact-1 for high-volume customer routes now (canary 10% -> 100% if stable). also bumping gateway upstream timeout to 30s for the duration.

maria_eng: rolling restart of proxy worker 3/12 done. connection counts dropping. patch for keepalive queued: `git rev 5e8c4a7` — will ship hotfix after smoke.

deploy-bot: canary rollback guard: CPU/GPU tail latencies within thresholds post-fallback.

ina_sre: after 20m: 504s dropped from 6% -> 0.4%. ephemeral port pool stabilized. preliminary: combination of client keepalive regression + sudden customer burst (concurrent large batch requests) drove port exhaustion.

jamie_oncall: good. open a warroom-incident postmortem ticket and capture timeline. Lina — please collect customer IDs and affected endpoints.

lina_support: collected list, adding to the incident ticket. will notify customers once we have root cause and ETA.

maria_eng: follow-ups from eng side:
- revert/patch client keepalive so idle gRPC streams close properly (`pr #4821`).
- add proactive circuit-breaker on per-customer concurrent requests at the gateway (default 200/conn).
- improve connection pool monitoring (alerts when ephemeral ports > 70% used).

ryan_prod: ops/action items:
- add a runbook step: when 5xx>1% for >5m, check ephemeral port usage and restart proxy worker one-by-one.
- temporary routing to fallback models as emergency mitigation.
- add per-route qps throttling toggle in the console.

ina_sre: SRE tasks:
- hotfix deploy for keepalive patch to us-west-2 by EOD.
- increase ephemeral port range on proxy hosts as a short-term safety net and document risk.
- run a synthetic load test mirroring customer batch patterns to validate fixes.

jamie_oncall: postmortem expectations:
- timeline (root), detection, mitigation, root cause (client keepalive + burst), what went wrong (no alert on ephemeral ports), and concrete action items with owners + ETA.

lina_support: drafting customer message for impacted accounts to apologize, explain mitigation, and offer credits if SLAs breached.

maria_eng: assign owners: `maria_eng` -> patch & PR; `ina_sre` -> hotfix rollout; `ryan_prod` -> routing/console controls; `lina_support` -> customer comms; `jamie_oncall` -> postmortem.

jamie_oncall: estimating full RCA & postmortem by EOD tomorrow. if anything changes I'll update thread. thanks all :thumbsup:

lina_support: quick note — we've had a few follow-on tickets noting longer-than-usual cold-start latencies when fallback flip occurred. we'll include perf regression checks.

maria_eng: noted — add perf smoke tests to the rollout job so fallback path has latency guard rails.

ina_sre: closing loop: 1h after mitigation, overall error budget restored. leaving thread open for postmortem drafts and action verification.

jamie_oncall: closing warroom in 1h if no regression. great work team!"
